ModMetaData.name: RimMT V0.9.3-T34D Aggressive Parallel Scanner
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT T34-D for RimWorld 1.5, based directly on the measured T34-C.4 baseline. Large JobGiver GenClosest scans are divided across the persistent RimMT worker pool. Worker threads execute live HasJobOnThing validators and, for reachable searches, live Reachability queries; the caller joins the current batch and performs deterministic source-order priority/distance selection. This is the aggressive full-parallel development branch.
